searchText: We could land eip4844 on a branch, might be a good answer… And merge to master once we have a name I'm seeing `eip-4844` showing up in various PRs now, I think that we either fix this now with a proper name or we go through pain later. Is there any good reason _not_ to pick a name and enforce it? (As far as I can see, worst case is that we have to change the name and we are no worse off than now.) I think we want to use the real name on master ideally Maybe do a release if we’re happy with withdrawals? 2 options I guess I think we're good with it (I'd worry more about state than withdrawals regarding potential to change), but given the likelihood that people are out on vacation time I'm not sure we'll have enough people actively agreeing for us to feel comfortable with it. Would basically enshrine the light client endpoints, we might not be that far along? <@881905303011086387> Yeh I’m on vacation atm just this is on my ‘early morning’ checks Do we just put the EIP on branch, and let it develop there? Still requires rename coming in but probably less messy Trouble is I'm seeing the `eip-4844` name showing up in other PRs (e.g. flashbots) and so if they merge we start to get ourselves in to a mess. There’s only a few of us that can merge… 🙂 On their repository? 🙂 Oh hehe We have a bunch in teku, that’ll be fun, but we rename a lot anyway I guess At least on beacon-apis repo we could restrict it on master I was mainly thinking True. Make it clear it’s not going to be called that Given it relies on KZG I can’t see it being in Capella, but I could be wrong heh I tend to agree, it seems like a major push to get all of the pieces in place prior to March (and indeed prior to that, for testnets).
